topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: They said the streets were paved with broken dreams, but sometimes, just sometimes, you find the gold. Got a call from an old connection, told me my college app essay was doing the rounds as a prime example of how to nail it. Always figured my way with words was more than just another hustle. Turns out, the kid in me had a few tricks up his sleeve. Figured if I could cut through the noise with honest ink, maybe, just maybe, there was room for straight shooters in this town. Guess I was right.
